segments.title: Weekly round-up
segments.text: Hello, I'm Nova, the Ventryx AI presenter. This is your weekly market round-up for the week ending Friday 13 November.

segments.title: Markets this week
segments.text: Here's how the markets closed the week. The S&P 500 finished up 2.5 per cent. The tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 was up 3.5 per cent, and here in London the FTSE 100 ended up 2.1 per cent. Bitcoin was down 13.3 per cent over seven days.

segments.title: Biggest movers
segments.bar: Advanced Micro Devices leads, First Solar lags
segments.text: Among the hundred big US stocks we track, the top riser was Advanced Micro Devices, up 18.9 per cent, followed by Broadcom and Arista Networks. At the other end, First Solar fell 14.8 per cent, with NVIDIA and Coinbase Global also lower.

segments.title: In the headlines
segments.text: In the news on Advanced Micro Devices, Motley Fool ran the headline: The Evidence Is Piling Up: AMD Could Be the Best Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock to Buy Amid the Sell-Off.

segments.title: Momentum top 5
segments.text: On the Ventryx momentum list, this month's five are Micron Technology, Dell, Marvell Technology, Intel and Advanced Micro Devices. All five are holding their places for now. The next swap is on Monday 30 November.

segments.title: Crypto top 5
segments.text: In crypto, our experimental top five are NEAR Protocol, Zcash, Arbitrum, Uniswap and Monero, with Bitcoin 12 per cent below its two-hundred-day average.

segments.title: Next week
segments.text: Looking ahead to the week of Monday 16 November. Results are due from NVIDIA and Home Depot (The) on Tuesday; Walmart on Thursday. And on the prediction market Polymarket, the question "Will Bitcoin dip to $60,000 in November?" is trading at about 46 per cent yes.
